quick.name: TPU Sync
quick.quote: Page: Apache-2.0 license; 'only .dev nightlies exist'. No open-sourcing date, no Qwen3 235B or 230 ms figure on the repo page or releases page ('There aren't any releases here'); weights movement only as 'tensor weight and activation migrations' between RL trainers and samplers. Web search (The New Stack, not openable): 230 ms is a Google benchmark.
quick.fix: Apache-2.0 and nightly-only verified; 9 November date and 230 ms Qwen3 figure NOT IN SOURCE on the linked repo (cite The New Stack for 230 ms as Google's number); 'weights between TPU memory, host DRAM and network' overstated, KV cache is what bridges HBM/host DRAM/remote nodes.
